scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend/typescript build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir backend/typescript typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm --dir backend/typescript test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:python && pnpm build
scripts.test:python: uv lock --project backend/python --check --offline --default-index https://pypi.org/simple && uv run --project backend/python --extra server --locked --default-index https://pypi.org/simple pytest backend/python/tests && uv run --project backend/python --locked --default-index https://pypi.org/simple ruff check backend/python && uv build --project backend/python
